provenance.method: Exact binary-rational cases and source-ordered binary32 oracle results. These are scalar equations, not GPU or Windows observations.

independent_derivations.band_low_cap_probe: len=400; floor(len/2)=200; low length caps at110 and has endpoints145..255; current_y=145 gives low weight1. High length uses band_step200 and endpoints100..300; 1-binary32(45/200) has bits3f466666.
independent_derivations.band_color_four_component: Weights are low_left=1 and high_left=0. Low mix is [1,1,1,1]. High mix selects [0,2,4,6]. Apply binary32 1.8 and add the low mix in source order; expected bits are listed above. The alpha component is included.
independent_derivations.gaussian_constant: The reviewed exact decimal polynomial is199999/200000. Source-ordered binary32 accumulation yields bits3f7fffaf.
independent_derivations.gaussian_asymmetric: The reviewed source-ordered binary32 oracle uses the pinned 25 exact binary-rational samples and yields bits3bf39c60 per component.

tolerance: Zero for each listed binary32 result.
